newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus Belavia begins Minsk-Beijing flights July.
newsitem.headline: Belarus Belavia begins Minsk-Beijing flights July.

text.p: Belarussian state-owned airline Belavia will begin scheduled passenger flights between Minsk and Beijing starting on July 26, the head of the state aviation agency said on Wednesday.
Grigory Fyodorov told a news conference Belarus needed new aircraft to service the route.

"We are considering the possibility of buying, through a leasing arrangement, two or three U.S. planes from the U.S. Boeing company or from the English-French-German Airbus company," Fyodorov said. The Airbus consortium also has a Spanish partner.
Belavia operates scheduled flights and charters from Belarus to 21 countries.
